_about: Settings for the Python harness (tempo_agent.py). Copy to agent-config.json in TEMPO_AGENT_HOME (default: this folder). It is git-ignored: keep real paths, hosts and names there, never in the repository. Every key is optional; ~ expands to your home folder. The Rust tempo-local-agent has its own config file: see perennos-tempo-local-agent/config.example.json.
owner_note: Sam runs a small design studio.
